title: [finding][repo:objectui] Studio Automations: on a read-only package, clicking a canvas node opens no inspector, so packaged flows' node configuration cannot be read
body:
Filing gate: **① product defect, class b, with reach measured at a public door** (the console). Severity: minor. Nothing is written and no lock is breached, but a promised read surface is missing.

**Measured.** Taken during the #12438 acceptance run (claim `5967871940`, B1/B2 evidence `5968206129` / `5968211463`). objectstack `main` was `a3873542ca`; the console was built fresh at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `89cad75d5570`; the app was the stock showcase.
- In Studio → Automations, on a **read-only** package (`com.example.showcase`), clicking any node on a flow canvas opens **no inspector**. The panel keeps its empty state: "Click a node on the canvas, and its configuration appears here."
- Reproduced with two click methods and in two fresh browser contexts, across 30/30 showcase flows.
- **Positive control:** the same click on an editable canvas (the Setup metadata-admin designer) opens the node inspector.

**Why it matters.** objectui#11124 fixed the earlier read-only defect, recorded as F-5 in QA run #20674: on a read-only package the inspector opened with editable inputs. That fix's own comment in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` promises that "node and edge selection still open the inspector read-only below". Today selection opens nothing, so an admin cannot read a packaged flow's node configuration in Studio at all.

**Mechanism (code read, at the pinned objectui; not re-verified with a debugger).** In `FlowCanvas.tsx`, `onNodePointerDown` returns early when the canvas is not editable, without `stopPropagation`. The background's `onBgPointerDown` then calls `onSelect(null)` and captures the pointer, which clears the selection the node click would have made.

**Who acts.** Triage routes this. The fix lands in objectstack-ai/objectui (`FlowCanvas.tsx`, the read-only pointer path), followed by the usual `.objectui-sha` bump. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118), session `session_01DiCSbmJrkzNhuEAier4VoJ`, from the #12438 run report. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Not this card:** "a clone reaches no Studio surface" is #21332 (open). It is a different defect with a different mechanism.

**Duplicate check.** I read objectstack issues (not PRs) updated since 2026-09-01, state all: 428 issues over 10 REST pages. ⚠️ Completeness is declared, not proven, because the walk stopped at the 10-page bound.
- `inspector`: 4 hits. #20674 is the QA run that recorded the earlier editable-inspector defect (F-5), now fixed. The other three are unrelated.
- `FlowCanvas|canvas node`: 0 hits.
- "read-only package" with canvas or inspector: 0 hits.
- Positive control: `studio`, 33 hits.

Dedupe words: Studio Automations read-only canvas node click no inspector · FlowCanvas onNodePointerDown stopPropagation readonly · objectui#11124 regression inspector.
